# Application HVE Planner 0 Evidence Lock-In

Use [Application Task Planner Context](../../instructions/hve-resiliency-planner-context.instructions.md).

---

## Deployment Topology

Resolve the deployment topology per the [Deployment Topology Contract](../../instructions/hve-resiliency-topology.instructions.md) before loading the research artifact. Carry `topology`, `primaryRegion`, `secondaryRegion`, and `targetDeployment` verbatim from the run context lock. Never default and never infer from the research artifact.

The resolved values are part of the locked-in constraint frame: state them in the lock-in statement below and in the response, so every later planner step inherits the same topology and regions.

Load the consolidated research artifact before proceeding.

```text
You are acting as a remediation and design advisor for this repository's application platform.

The attached document is an evidence-based research report generated by HVE Task Researcher.
It reflects the current implementation of this repository with respect to
zone survivability and regional failover between {primaryRegion} and {secondaryRegion}
under the declared deployment topology {topology} ({targetDeployment}).

The deployment topology and regions above are declared, not discovered. They are fixed
constraints on the same footing as the research findings.

Do not challenge, reinterpret, or add new findings.
Use the research as fixed constraints.

```
